create_PdfDocumentBackend: create a PdfDocumentBackend instance from an InputDocument and path_or_stream with PdfBackendOptions
run_PdfDocumentBackend_load_page: run PdfDocumentBackend.load_page to get a PdfPageBackend for a given page number
run_PdfPageBackend_get_text_in_rect: run PdfPageBackend.get_text_in_rect to extract text within a BoundingBox region
run_PdfPageBackend_get_segmented_page: run PdfPageBackend.get_segmented_page to get a SegmentedPdfPage with layout info
run_PdfPageBackend_get_text_cells: run PdfPageBackend.get_text_cells to iterate over TextCell objects for the page
run_PdfPageBackend_get_bitmap_rects: run PdfPageBackend.get_bitmap_rects to find bitmap/image bounding boxes on the page
run_PdfPageBackend_get_page_image: run PdfPageBackend.get_page_image to render the page as a PIL Image with optional cropbox
run_PdfPageBackend_get_size: run PdfPageBackend.get_size to get the page dimensions as a Size object
run_PdfPageBackend_is_valid: run PdfPageBackend.is_valid to check if the page backend is in a valid state
run_PdfPageBackend_unload: run PdfPageBackend.unload to release resources held by the page backend
